functions.description: Returns a pointer to a null-terminated C string representing the DUix library version. Intended for retrieving and displaying/logging the library version at runtime. No arguments are required. Ownership/lifetime of the returned memory is not documented; based on common patterns for version getters, treat it as a read-only, possibly static string. If you need to retain the value long-term or across library unload, copy it into caller-managed storage. Other behavior (e.g., thread safety or null returns) is not documented.
requirements: Do not modify the returned string (it is const).
Do not free or deallocate the returned pointer; ownership is not provided to the caller (typically static storage).
Treat the return value as a null-terminated UTF-8/ASCII C string; copy it if you need to persist it beyond immediate use.
